slides.title: Callables, Generics, and TypeVar
slides.prompt: `Callable[[ParamTypes], ReturnType]` annotates functions passed as arguments. `TypeVar` creates generic type variables that preserve relationships between function arguments and return types.

slides.title: TypeVar Declaration Import
slides.prompt: Fill in the construct imported from typing to instantiate a generic type variable.

slides.title: Callable Type Hint Signature
slides.prompt: How do you annotate a function parameter `callback` that accepts a `str` and `int` and returns a `bool`?

slides.title: Generic Class Inheriting Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the base class from typing used to define a custom generic container class.
slides.codeSnippet:
from typing import Generic, TypeVar

T = TypeVar('T')

class Stack(___[T]):
    pass

slides.title: Bounded TypeVar Constraints
slides.prompt: How do you constrain a `TypeVar` named `T` so that it accepts only numeric types (`int` or `float`)?

slides.title: Callable Arbitrary Arguments Notation
slides.prompt: Fill in the ellipse marker used in Callable to accept any number/type of arguments: `Callable[___, ReturnType]`.
slides.codeSnippet:
from collections.abc import Callable

func: Callable[..., int]
